items.title: AstraZeneca shares slump after $400bn BMS merger rumours
items.summary: One of the largest global pharma companies would be created if a deal were to materialise.

items.title: What will health and social care look like under Andy Burnham?
items.summary: New UK PM Andy Burnham enters office with experience of the health sector, having previously been health secretary under Gordon Brown.

items.title: IMPACT Therapeutics grants Pharmanovia exclusive $488m rights to senaparib
items.summary: IMPACT Therapeutics and Pharmanovia have entered an exclusive licensing deal worth up to $488.3m, giving Pharmanovia rights to manufacture, develop, and commercialise senaparib in 66 countries.

items.title: Ratio Therapeutics secures $70m Series C funding for cancer radiotherapy
items.summary: Ratio Therapeutics, a US-based developer of radiopharmaceuticals for cancer treatment, has closed a $70m Series C financing round.

items.title: Sublingual semaglutide offered to UK practices despite Novo Nordisk concerns
items.summary: Sublingual semaglutide, which does not hold marketing authorisation, is touted to minimise gastric issues.
